Maintenance release based on master, without the clan-assist / loot-filter PR.

- Handle timed attack reward popups at 33%, 66%, and 100% by waiting for automatic selection, then resuming the existing strategy. Battle exit rules remain unchanged.
- Preserve hero ability clicks and relocate their slots when a reward shifts the troop bar.
- Improve builder-menu names and complete cost reads at 16:9, allow scrolling to settle, and require consistent currency when confirming an upgrade target.
- Exclude blue magic-item Upgrade buttons from resource upgrades.
- Fix false unaffordable-price warnings on bottom-bar Upgrade buttons by checking the price above the label.
- Support selected seasonal crafting Confirm buttons when the displayed price and currency match the chosen upgrade.

Download **BasePilot.exe**. Tesseract is bundled. **BasePilot.exe.sha256** contains its SHA-256 checksum.

Validation includes automated regressions, saved failure-screen checks, live reward/hero/battle-exit testing, and a live Army Camp re-find with purchasing disabled. Auto-upgrade remains beta; OCR can still skip uncertain screens.
